OUR MISSION

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.18.0″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Poppins|600|||||||” text_text_color=”gcid-c73b7123-9f92-4d10-9391-3fa47a4e5fd5″ text_font_size=”1.5rem” background_color=”#FFFFFF” text_orientation=”center” custom_margin_tablet=”” custom_margin_phone=”||21px||false|false” custom_margin_last_edited=”on|phone” custom_padding=”0rem||0rem||true|false” text_font_size_tablet=”1.5rem” text_font_size_phone=”1.1rem” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” global_colors_info=”{%22gcid-c73b7123-9f92-4d10-9391-3fa47a4e5fd5%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}”]

A Mission of Peace

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_image src=”https://spiritofislam.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Heading-Divider.svg” title_text=”Heading Divider” align=”center” force_fullwidth=”on” _builder_version=”4.18.0″ _module_preset=”default” min_height=”15px” min_height_tablet=”20px” min_height_phone=”10px” min_height_last_edited=”on|phone” global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_image][et_pb_image src=”https://spiritofislam.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/maulana-wahiduddin-khan.webp” title_text=”maulana-wahiduddin-khan” align=”center” _builder_version=”4.18.0″ _module_preset=”default” max_width=”50%” max_width_tablet=”60%” max_width_phone=”75%” max_width_last_edited=”on|phone” global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_image][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.18.0″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Noir Pro Regular||||||||” text_text_color=”gcid-c73b7123-9f92-4d10-9391-3fa47a4e5fd5″ text_font_size=”1.1rem” background_color=”#FFFFFF” text_orientation=”justified” max_width=”90%” max_width_tablet=”90%” max_width_phone=”80%” max_width_last_edited=”on|phone” module_alignment=”center” custom_padding=”0rem||0rem||true|false” global_colors_info=”{%22gcid-c73b7123-9f92-4d10-9391-3fa47a4e5fd5%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}”]

Maulana Wahiduddin Khan, having studied Islam from its original sources—the Quran and Hadith—says with certainty that the political interpretation of Islam is an innovation and the real Islam, as followed by Prophet Muhammad and his early followers, is based on peace, compassion and tolerance.

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.18.0″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Noir Pro Regular||||||||” text_text_color=”gcid-c73b7123-9f92-4d10-9391-3fa47a4e5fd5″ text_font_size=”1.1rem” background_color=”#FFFFFF” text_orientation=”justified” max_width=”90%” max_width_tablet=”90%” max_width_phone=”80%” max_width_last_edited=”on|phone” module_alignment=”center” custom_padding=”0rem||0rem||true|false” global_colors_info=”{%22gcid-c73b7123-9f92-4d10-9391-3fa47a4e5fd5%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}”]

Our goal is to bring about an intellectual revolution in the individuals by re-engineering their minds towards positivity so that they become peaceful members of society.

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.18.0″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Cita Pro Bold Italic|500|||||||” text_text_color=”gcid-c73b7123-9f92-4d10-9391-3fa47a4e5fd5″ text_font_size=”1.1rem” background_color=”#FFFFFF” text_orientation=”justified” max_width=”90%” max_width_tablet=”90%” max_width_phone=”80%” max_width_last_edited=”on|phone” module_alignment=”center” custom_padding=”0rem||0rem||true|false” hover_enabled=”0″ global_colors_info=”{%22gcid-c73b7123-9f92-4d10-9391-3fa47a4e5fd5%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

❝   In this world, unity is achievable only by learning to unite in spite of differences, rather than insisting on unity without differences. For, the total eradication of differences is an impossibility. The Secret of attaining peace in life is tolerance of disturbance of the peace. ❞

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.18.0″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Noir Pro Regular|500|||||||” text_text_color=”gcid-c73b7123-9f92-4d10-9391-3fa47a4e5fd5″ text_font_size=”1.1rem” background_color=”#FFFFFF” text_orientation=”right” max_width=”90%” max_width_tablet=”90%” max_width_phone=”80%” max_width_last_edited=”on|phone” module_alignment=”center” custom_padding=”0rem||0rem||true|false” hover_enabled=”0″ global_colors_info=”{%22gcid-c73b7123-9f92-4d10-9391-3fa47a4e5fd5%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

– Maulana Wahiduddin Khan

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]
